incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-prod` (INC-4521) - https://pd.example/INC-4521

pagerduty-bot: page sent to schedule `prod-inference-schedule` at 2025-03-03T10:12:03Z

jamie: got the page but I'm not on prod-inference-schedule? I was on infra-oncall this week.

olivia: same here, the page hit a bunch of devs who aren't on inference rotation.

sanjay: looking now — PD incident shows escalation policy pointed to `schedule:old-inference-id` (deprecated). We rolled schedules last week and didn't update the service binding.

jamie: that would explain it. customers are seeing a spike in 502s to the hosted API around 10:11 UTC. Is anyone actively responding?

olivia: acked the PD incident to stop further noisy pages :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: acknowledged by olivia at 2025-03-03T10:13:12Z

sanjay: quick mitigation: I applied a temporary route override to send pages to `inference-sre` team. Command I ran:```sh
pd service update inference-prod --escalation-policy inference-sre-policy
```

maria: thanks. I also added a maintenance window on the service to suppress further escalation while we root cause.

jamie: I'm looking at logs — K8s ingress is returning 502s from shard gputier-3, kernel OOMs seen in pod logs. Pasting snippet:```
[10:11:05] inference-gpu-3 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2145 (python)
[10:11:06] inference-gpu-3 containerd: container exited with status 137
```

olivia: can we spin up extra inference replicas or scale to a larger instance class? We have reserved capacity in Dedicated but autoscale didn't trigger.

sanjay: scaling now:```sh
kubectl scale deployment inference-serving --replicas=18 -n prod
```

jamie: scaling accepted by cluster, new pods scheduling. Adding pod affinity tweak to avoid gputier-3 overload.

maria: I updated the incident in PD: noted "routing misconfiguration -> wrong schedule id" and that we've applied temporary override + scaling. Marked customer impact as "partial degradation" for hosted API.

olivia: quick check: the PD schedule sync job failed last night with 504. That explains the stale schedule id. I'll re-run the sync and fix the service binding. Command:```sh
scripts/sync-pd-schedules --fix-mismatches
```

sanjay: pinging eng-infra to add a post-commit CI check so schedule changes update service bindings in PD. tagging @eng-infra.

jamie: confirmed errors dropped after scaling, 502 rate down to baseline at 10:18. I'll stay on this until we confirm pods stable.

maria: good work. Next steps: (1) reopen follow-up ticket to repair PD bindings and add CI check, (2) postmortem draft with timeline, (3) review autoscaler thresholds for Dedicated. I'll own the follow-up ticket.

olivia: added thread note and linked customers: CS ticket #C-998 linked.

incident-bot: incident INC-4521 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owner: maria. Reminder: run post-incident review within 48h.
